relation_note: the governing spec's fixed family (morpheus_training_and_evaluation_spec.md 0.7), morpheus_encoder.learned_search.relation_v03 (Agent M, commit bfc40ed): kernel ridge on 256 random Fourier features of the set (Gaussian kernel, median-heuristic bandwidth on proposal rows, fixed RFF directions per set size, RFF_SEED 20261021) plus the set linearly plus an intercept; inputs standardised by proposal-row statistics; penalty from {0.01, 0.1, 1, 10} by leave-one-patient-out CV on proposal rows; fitted to the response after the nuisance ridge (log depth; per-patient intercepts = within-patient standardisation; penalty from {0.1, 1, 10, 100, 1000} by LOPO); general gain = R2(nuisance + f_S, D_R) - R2(nuisance, D_R) with a 200-draw held-out-patient bootstrap CI; decomposition family = every proper set partition of S, each block its own 256-RFF map, fitted jointly; nulls unchanged (spatial_block, within_patient_perm, interaction_break; the protocol's draw count; p = (1 + #null >= observed)/(draws + 1)), re-scoring the fixed proposal fit on nulled D_R (interaction_break re-predicts with the first constituent block-swapped); validation rule unchanged (held-out full R2 > 0 and gain CI lower bound > 0); batched on the GPU
higher_order_flag: receipt row field higher_order = (G_HO patient-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0) AND (held-out full-model R2 > 0) under relation v03_rff, where G_HO = held-out gain(full) - max over proper partitions of held-out gain(partition), the maximum taken inside every bootstrap draw; the funnel tallies n_fold_rows_higher_order and n_frozen_higher_order beside the validated counts

outputs.general_discoveries: internal hypotheses (rule above) regardless of shape: linear, additive, conditional or joint; each with pooled general gain + CI, the per-row B_known and B_decomp gains and its proposer
outputs.higher_order_discoveries: the subset of general discoveries with k >= 2 whose pooled G_HO (relation v03_rff decomposition family) has a patient-bootstrap CI lower bound > 0 with pooled held-out full-model R2 > 0; per-fold rows carry higher_order
outputs.note: a discovery is never dropped for being linear or simple; G_HO only marks which discoveries additionally require the joint object

reporting.status: reported for every receipt row and every frozen hypothesis, never a gate
reporting.baselines: training spec 0.8 under relation v03_rff (Agent M 25fce7e): B_nuis = nuisance ridge (log depth; per-patient intercepts = within-patient standardisation); B_known = nuisance + the hest_multi programme scores (Hallmark + Gavish) after the target's exclusions (the target programme, its member genes, |r| >= 0.9 proxies and every programme with gene-set overlap coefficient >= 0.2 removed) + the three composition variables (CellViT PanNuke Neoplastic / Inflammatory / Connective fractions where every sample has a segmentation, else the top three programme principal axes; source recorded in episode_info.composition_source), ridge with LOPO penalty on D_P; B_decomp(S) = the best proper partition of S in the same family

row_fields.B_nuis: gain_B_nuis with gain_B_nuis_ci (identical to decomposition.gain_general / gain_general_ci and replication_gain / replication_gain_ci)
row_fields.B_known: gain_B_known with gain_B_known_ci (decomposition.gain_known / gain_known_ci; support LOPO decomposition.gain_known_proposal; columns used in decomposition.known_covariates)
row_fields.B_decomp: G_HO_B_decomp with G_HO_B_decomp_ci and best_decomposition (decomposition.G_HO / G_HO_ci; decomposition.gain_decompositions, gain_joint_vs_additive); the receipt's best_decomposition is chosen on held-out gain inside each bootstrap draw

reporting.replaces: the N/B1/B2/B3 ladder (dbench.scripts.decomposition_ladder), which does not run under v03_rff in the hest_multi runner; no ladder step is run for these campaigns

pass_counts.reported: per cohort and per family, from funnel_aggregate.json baseline_pass_counts (dbench.prospective_campaign; same pass rule: >= 3 of 5 folds, required structured nulls p <= 0.05, BH q <= 0.10 within family): passes B_nuis (the internal rule); passes B_known (folds restricted to gain_B_known CI lower bound > 0); passes B_decomp (folds restricted to higher_order rows); passes B_known and B_decomp
pass_counts.status: nothing gated; the finding classes A-F keep their meaning
pass_counts.downstream: external replication and characterisation run on every B_nuis pass as before
pass_counts.paper_object_count: the B_known column, with the higher-order (B_known and B_decomp) subset marked
pass_counts.state_cards: the validation section of every state card carries the four passes and their folds

morphology_view_fields.definition: cosine similarities of the frozen H-Optimus-0 spot embedding, standardised per dimension on the fold's covered D_P spots, to the 33 kept centres of the frozen v03 morphology dictionary (runs/development/learned_search_v03/morphology_dictionary, centres.npz sha256 38102157ad19130639614ba60f78ea85a153c4ad0d6e5746bb8dcf70988488ad; three-study population rule); covered spots only, nothing imputed
morphology_view_fields.column_names: morph_dictionary_v03:morph:kNN (NN = original centre index; kept list in PROVENANCE.json)

context_conditioned_programme.rule: every hypothesis carries >= 1 own variable and >= 1 nbr6, nbr18 or contrast variable; applied by the learned search at candidate generation and by the runner as a post-filter on every proposer

cross_modal_sets.rule: every hypothesis carries >= 1 raw_genes or programmes variable and >= 1 morph_dictionary_v03 variable; applied at generation and as a runner post-filter

programme_from_morphology.rule: candidate_views restrict the set to morph_dictionary_v03 variables

morphology_from_molecular.rule: candidate_views restrict the set to molecular variables; the target's own column and columns with within-patient |r| >= 0.9 to it are dropped

seconds_per_cell.previous_engine: v07_ho CPU path: 595 s for a kidney_injury cell
seconds_per_cell.extrapolation_rule: about 2.5 min per cell for Meylan (74k spots), extrapolated by Agent M from spot count (not run: blind cohort); other cohorts scale by spot count
